sentences.text: In the matter of : Asis Kumar Tewari

... Petitioner(
 Mr. Ayan Bhattacharjee  Mr. Jisan Iqbal Hossain  ... for the Petitioner(s)
 Mr. Madhusudan Sur, APP  Ms. Snigdha Saha  ... for the State-respondent(s)
A comprehensive report has been submitted by the State which reflects that sanction has been granted by the Secretary, WBBSE.
Let the same be kept with the record.
Mr. Bhattacharjee, learned senior advocate, submits that the petitioner is in custody for one year ten months.
The investigation is complete and charge- sheet/supplementary charge-sheet has been submitted before the jurisdictional court.
Having considered that the issue relating to grant of sanction consumed substantial period of time, I am of the view that the proceedings should be expedited at the trial court.
Learned advocate for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

The case was initiated pursuant to the directions passed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India by the Hon'ble High Court and the investigation has already been completed,
charge-sheet/supplementary charge-sheet has also been submitted before the jurisdictional court.
